gates.description: Compiler pipeline phases must be defined and separated
Test suite must be produced — compiler without tests is a random code generator
Error diagnostic code must exist — errors need precise location and message
No context-free grammar parsed via regex

anti_patterns.description: One giant function that lexes, parses, type-checks, and generates code in a single pass
Spending weeks on loop unrolling when the compiler still has type-checking bugs
Using regular expressions to parse context-free or context-sensitive languages
No tests — the compiler generates random code and nobody knows
Works for hello world, crashes on generic types with recursive bounds

escalation_triggers: Soundness bug discovered in the type system requiring design-level fix
Code generation bug produces incorrect machine code for a specific target
Compiler cannot meet performance targets without fundamental architecture change
New language feature requires IR changes affecting all existing passes
Language specification is ambiguous and a design decision is needed

output_certifications: Compiler pipeline phases separated (lexer, parser, semantic analysis, IR, codegen)
Test suite covers all language features
Error diagnostics include precise location and actionable message
No soundness bugs in type checker
Benchmark suite exists for compilation performance
